title: Who Goes MAGA? “His Substack has 10,000 subscribers and a name like...
content: Who Goes MAGA? “His Substack has 10,000 subscribers and a name like ‘Uncomfortable Truths’ or ‘Against the Grain.’ He has an advanced degree & a career in academia or journalism. He positions himself as a truth-teller willing to say what others won’t.”
author: Jason Kottke
